// Inline answer key. To refresh: edit docs/trainee-evaluation/answer-key.json
// in the repo and re-import this workflow, or replace this node with an HTTP GET
// to the committed raw URL when trainers need to edit without redeploys.
const ANSWER_KEY = {
  "version": 2,
  "passing_score": 17.5,
  "source_table_id": "tblnGRAlrjXQhfRO",
  "source_app_token": "R0XnbNkwdaY4A1sNPcklT2MTgqe",
  "fields": {
    "name": "COMPLETE NAME",
    "email": "ACTIVE EMAIL ADDRESS",
    "total": "TOTAL",
    "result": "RESULTS"
  },
  "questions": [
    {
      "id": "q1",
      "type": "exact",
      "field_name": "This is where you can easily view open visits on a specific day or date range that you can offer to a caregiver asking for available shifts.",
      "score_field": "1 (Caregiver Pivot)",
      "expected": "C. Caregiver Pivot",
      "weight": 1,
      "normalize": "trim_lower"
    },
    {
      "id": "q2",
      "type": "exact",
      "field_name": "This is how you send out a shift to recommended caregivers.",
      "score_field": "2 Sent Out",
      "expected": "D. Click open visit bar > Send to Caregivers > Add Comment (as needed) > Click Recommend > Tick checkboxes of aides highlighted in green > Click Okay > Hit Send Button",
      "weight": 1,
      "normalize": "trim_lower"
    },
    {
      "id": "q3",
      "type": "exact",
      "field_name": "This is where you can view the visits requested or picked up by the caregivers from the shifts we sent out via the AxisCare app.",
      "score_field": "3 (Alerts ST)",
      "expected": "C. Alerts Sub-tab",
      "weight": 1,
      "normalize": "trim_lower"
    },
    {
      "id": "q4",
      "type": "exact",
      "field_name": "This feature in WellSky is useful when searching for caregivers to fill shifts for clients. It allows you to filter for caregivers who fulfill specific criteria needed by clients for a particular shift. You can also mass message caregivers and fill shifts in real time.",
      "score_field": "4 (CareFinder)",
      "expected": "D. CareFinder",
      "weight": 1,
      "normalize": "trim_lower"
    },
    {
      "id": "q5",
      "type": "exact",
      "field_name": "These are basic activities required for taking care of oneself. These include things such as bathing, toileting, continence, dressing, feeding and mobility.",
      "score_field": "5 (ADLs)",
      "expected": "A. Activities of Daily Living",
      "weight": 1,
      "normalize": "trim_lower"
    },
    {
      "id": "q6",
      "type": "exact",
      "field_name": "These are activities that enable an individual to live independently within the community. These Include such things as housekeeping/cleaning, laundry, money management, meal preparation, medication management and shopping/transportation.",
      "score_field": "6 (IADLs)",
      "expected": "B. Instrumental Activities of Daily Living",
      "weight": 1,
      "normalize": "trim_lower"
    },
    {
      "id": "q7",
      "type": "exact",
      "field_name": "What are the usual tags to include for a call log?",
      "score_field": "7 (A)",
      "expected": "A. Client, Caregiver, User, Category",
      "weight": 1,
      "normalize": "trim_lower"
    },
    {
      "id": "q8",
      "type": "exact",
      "field_name": "The scheduler called the client to inform that the aide will not be able to attend to her shift that night due to a fire incident in their apartment complex and she is still cleaning up their unit, as advised by the caregiver. The client acknowledged and stated that they do not need any aide replacement since their daughter is at home.",
      "score_field": "8 (No)",
      "expected": "No",
      "weight": 1,
      "normalize": "trim_lower"
    },
    {
      "id": "q9",
      "type": "exact",
      "field_name": "Mr. Parker called to ask the mobile number of his caregiver yesterday since he needs to discuss some errands for tomorrow. The scheduler acknowledged and ended the call by providing the caregiver's number to the client. This is to ensure that all information needed will be explained well to the caregiver",
      "score_field": "9 (No)",
      "expected": "No",
      "weight": 1,
      "normalize": "trim_lower"
    },
    {
      "id": "q10",
      "type": "exact",
      "field_name": "Your office/admin partners advised the team to remove a certain caregiver from a case due to being unreliable and deemed not fit for the case. The scheduler updated the calendar of the aide and informed her that there have been schedule changes and we'll keep her posted for updates.",
      "score_field": "10 (Yes)",
      "expected": "Yes",
      "weight": 1,
      "normalize": "trim_lower"
    },
    {
      "id": "q11",
      "type": "exact",
      "field_name": "Client requested to not have the caregiver she had yesterday moving forward. Client stated that the aide keeps on using her phone during her shift. The scheduler put a client block on the aide's profile and did not inform the caregiver.",
      "score_field": "11 (No)",
      "expected": "No",
      "weight": 1,
      "normalize": "trim_lower"
    },
    {
      "id": "q12",
      "type": "scenario",
      "field_name": "Given the following image reference, create an SMS response and acknowledge the caregiver who called off.-SCENARIO: May 2nd (Friday) You received a call at 6:00 PM from caregiver Daniel informing that he won't make it to his scheduled visit with his client Harold later tonight due car problem. -Text",
      "score_field": "12 (CG LMCO)",
      "prompt": "Caregiver Daniel called at 6 PM on Fri May 2 to say he cannot make tonight's visit with client Harold due to a car problem. Write an SMS to Daniel acknowledging the call-off and asking him to keep you posted.",
      "expected_points": [
        "addresses the caregiver by name (Daniel)",
        "thanks or acknowledges receipt of the call-off",
        "asks the caregiver to keep you posted or update on their condition",
        "professional and empathetic tone"
      ],
      "required_keywords": [
        "daniel"
      ],
      "weight": 1,
      "max_score": 5,
      "needs_trainer_review": true
    },
    {
      "id": "q13",
      "type": "scenario",
      "field_name": "Given the following image reference, create an SMS spiel to ask outgoing caregiver if they can extend.-SCENARIO: May 2nd (Friday) You received a call at 6:00 PM from caregiver Daniel informing that he won't make it to his scheduled visit later tonight due car problem.-Text",
      "score_field": "13 (Extend)",
      "prompt": "Daniel called off tonight's visit with Harold due to a car problem. The outgoing caregiver is Annabel. Write an SMS to Annabel asking if she can extend her shift to cover until a replacement is found.",
      "expected_points": [
        "addresses the outgoing caregiver (Annabel or appropriate name)",
        "explains that the incoming aide (Daniel) called off",
        "explicitly asks if the outgoing CG can extend their shift",
        "mentions finding an aide replacement or that the client cannot be left alone",
        "professional, polite, and appreciative tone"
      ],
      "required_keywords": [
        "extend"
      ],
      "weight": 1,
      "max_score": 5,
      "needs_trainer_review": true
    },
    {
      "id": "q14",
      "type": "scenario",
      "field_name": "Given the following image reference, create an SMS spiel to offer the open visit to our caregivers.-SCENARIO: May 2nd (Friday) You received a call at 6:00 PM from caregiver Daniel informing that he won't make it to his scheduled 8PM - 8AM visit later tonight due car problem.-Text",
      "score_field": "14 (Open Visit)",
      "prompt": "Daniel called off his 8 PM – 8 AM visit tonight with Harold. Write a brief SMS broadcast to offer this open visit to other caregivers.",
      "expected_points": [
        "clearly states there is an urgent open shift or coverage need",
        "includes the shift times (8P-8A or 8PM-8AM)",
        "asks caregivers to respond if available (by message or call)",
        "professional and concise broadcast tone"
      ],
      "required_keywords": [
        "8"
      ],
      "weight": 1,
      "max_score": 5,
      "needs_trainer_review": true
    },
    {
      "id": "q15",
      "type": "scenario",
      "field_name": "Given the following image reference, create an SMS spiel to inform the client that caregiver called off and we're still looking for a replacement.-SCENARIO: May 2nd (Friday) You received a call at 6:00 PM from caregiver Daniel informing that he won't make it to his scheduled visit later tonight due car problem. Client name is Harold. Responsible Party's (Son) name is Paul.-Text",
      "score_field": "15 (Search)",
      "prompt": "Daniel called off tonight's visit with Harold. The outgoing aide has been asked to stay. Write an SMS to Harold's son Paul informing them of the call-off and that a replacement is being actively secured.",
      "expected_points": [
        "addresses the responsible party or client by name (Paul or Harold)",
        "informs that the caregiver called off",
        "states a replacement is actively being sought",
        "mentions asking the outgoing aide to stay or extend",
        "commits to providing an update and thanks for understanding"
      ],
      "required_keywords": [
        "replacement"
      ],
      "weight": 1,
      "max_score": 5,
      "needs_trainer_review": true
    },
    {
      "id": "q16",
      "type": "scenario",
      "field_name": "Given the following image reference, create an SMS spiel to update the client NO caregiver is available to pick up the shift-SCENARIO: May 2nd (Friday) You received a call at 6:00 PM from caregiver Daniel informing that he won't make it to his scheduled visit later tonight due car problem. Client name is Harold. Responsible Party's (Son) name is Paul.-Text",
      "score_field": "16 (No CG)",
      "prompt": "After reaching out to all available caregivers, no one can cover Harold's visit tonight. Write an SMS to Paul (Harold's son) informing them that no replacement was found.",
      "expected_points": [
        "addresses the responsible party or client by name (Paul or Harold)",
        "clearly states no caregiver could be secured",
        "mentions having reached out to all available caregivers",
        "sincerely apologizes for the inconvenience",
        "professional and empathetic tone"
      ],
      "required_keywords": [
        "unable"
      ],
      "weight": 1,
      "max_score": 5,
      "needs_trainer_review": true
    },
    {
      "id": "q17",
      "type": "scenario",
      "field_name": "Given the following image reference, compose an update to post in your GROUP CHAT with your office admin partners.-SCENARIO: May 2nd (Friday) caregiver Annabel informed that she will be late for 30 minutes to highway traffic.-Text",
      "score_field": "17 (CG Late)",
      "prompt": "Client: Harold. Caregiver Annabel advised she will be 30 minutes late due to highway traffic on Fri May 2. Client has been informed and visit time adjusted. Compose a group-chat update to your office admin partners.",
      "expected_points": [
        "includes the client name (Harold)",
        "names the caregiver (Annabel)",
        "states she will be 30 minutes late",
        "states the reason (highway traffic)",
        "notes the client has been informed or visit time adjusted",
        "concise, admin memo-style tone"
      ],
      "required_keywords": [
        "annabel",
        "30"
      ],
      "weight": 1,
      "max_score": 5,
      "needs_trainer_review": true
    },
    {
      "id": "q18",
      "type": "scenario",
      "field_name": "Given the following image reference, compose an update to post in your GROUP CHAT with your office admin partners.-SCENARIO: Client's son, Paul called to inform that he will take his father to a doctor's appointment and they don't need an aide on Sunday, May 4th.-Text",
      "score_field": "18 (Visit Cancel)",
      "prompt": "Client: Harold. Paul (Harold's son) called to cancel the visit on Sunday 05/04 because he is taking his father to a doctor's appointment. Shift has been updated and CG has been informed. Compose a group-chat update to your office admin partners.",
      "expected_points": [
        "includes the client name (Harold)",
        "names the responsible party (Paul) and their relationship (son)",
        "states the visit is cancelled for Sunday or the specific date (05/04)",
        "states the reason (doctor's appointment)",
        "notes the shift has been updated and the caregiver informed",
        "concise, admin memo-style tone"
      ],
      "required_keywords": [
        "paul",
        "cancel"
      ],
      "weight": 1,
      "max_score": 5,
      "needs_trainer_review": true
    },
    {
      "id": "q19",
      "type": "scenario",
      "field_name": "Given the following image reference, compose an update to post in your GROUP CHAT with your office admin partners.-SCENARIO: May 2nd (Friday) You received a call at 6:00 PM from caregiver Daniel informing that he won't make it to his scheduled visit with his client Harold later tonight due car problem. -Text",
      "score_field": "19 (CG absent)",
      "prompt": "Client: Harold. Caregiver Daniel LMCO (last-minute call-off) due to car problem, 8 PM – 8 AM shift. Shift sent out via app. Reaching out to recommended and other caregivers. Asked outgoing CG to extend; waiting for response. Compose a group-chat update to your office admin partners.",
      "expected_points": [
        "includes the client name (Harold)",
        "names the caregiver (Daniel)",
        "states LMCO or call-off due to car problem",
        "includes the shift times (8P-8A or 8PM-8AM)",
        "notes actions taken: shift sent out and reaching out to caregivers",
        "mentions asking the outgoing CG to extend",
        "concise, admin memo-style tone"
      ],
      "required_keywords": [
        "daniel",
        "harold"
      ],
      "weight": 1,
      "max_score": 5,
      "needs_trainer_review": true
    },
    {
      "id": "q20",
      "type": "scenario",
      "field_name": "Update the shift memo/note based on the scenario.",
      "score_field": "20 (Memo flu)",
      "prompt": "Scenario: 05/01 – Caregiver Matthew called off (LMCO) due to flu. Logged by Kim. Write a brief shift memo/note for this event.",
      "expected_points": [
        "records the date (05/01 or equivalent)",
        "names the caregiver (Matthew)",
        "states the caregiver called off or LMCO",
        "states the reason (flu or illness)",
        "includes the initials or name of the person who handled/logged it (Kim)"
      ],
      "required_keywords": [
        "flu",
        "matthew"
      ],
      "weight": 1,
      "max_score": 5,
      "needs_trainer_review": true
    },
    {
      "id": "q21",
      "type": "scenario",
      "field_name": "Update the shift memo/note based on the scenario. 2",
      "score_field": "21 (Memo Clock)",
      "prompt": "Scenario: 05/01 – Caregiver Matthew had a manual clock-in recorded at 7:54 AM. Logged by Kim. Write a brief shift memo/note for this event.",
      "expected_points": [
        "records the date (05/01 or equivalent)",
        "names the caregiver (Matthew)",
        "indicates a manual clock-in or time discrepancy",
        "includes the specific time (7:54 AM or similar)",
        "includes the initials or name of the person who handled/logged it (Kim)"
      ],
      "required_keywords": [
        "clock",
        "matthew"
      ],
      "weight": 1,
      "max_score": 5,
      "needs_trainer_review": true
    },
    {
      "id": "q22",
      "type": "scenario",
      "field_name": "Update the shift memo/note based on the scenario. 3",
      "score_field": "22 (Extended)",
      "prompt": "Scenario: 05/01 – Caregiver Matthew extended until 8:58 PM due to food and bathroom assist. Logged by Kim. Write a brief shift memo/note for this event.",
      "expected_points": [
        "records the date (05/01 or equivalent)",
        "names the caregiver (Matthew)",
        "states the shift was extended",
        "includes the new end time (8:58 PM or similar)",
        "states the reason (food & bathroom assist or similar task)",
        "includes the initials or name of the person who handled/logged it (Kim)"
      ],
      "required_keywords": [
        "extend",
        "matthew"
      ],
      "weight": 1,
      "max_score": 5,
      "needs_trainer_review": true
    },
    {
      "id": "q23",
      "type": "scenario",
      "field_name": "OWN UNDERSTANDING | A client is exploring options to help cover the cost of ongoing homecare services. They mention having a Long-Term Care (LTC) insurance policy, while another client asks if they can use their Veterans Affairs (VA) benefits for similar services. What are the key differences between Long-Term Care insurance and Veterans Affairs (VA) benefits in terms usage for homecare services?",
      "score_field": "23 (LTCI VA)",
      "prompt": "Explain the key differences between Long-Term Care (LTC) insurance and Veterans Affairs (VA) benefits as they apply to paying for homecare services.",
      "expected_points": [
        "notes LTC insurance is a private policy purchased by the individual",
        "notes VA benefits are government benefits for eligible veterans",
        "mentions eligibility differences (anyone who qualifies vs veterans/spouses)",
        "mentions coverage/usage differences (e.g., LTC often reimburses; VA may provide direct services or aid & attendance)",
        "explanation is coherent and demonstrates understanding, not just keyword dropping"
      ],
      "required_keywords": [
        "ltc",
        "va"
      ],
      "weight": 1,
      "max_score": 5,
      "needs_trainer_review": true
    }
  ]
};
return [{ json: ANSWER_KEY }];

Thank you for your time and effort!

Best regards,
TeamUp Recruitment Team` }}
